title: The Same Swing
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 124
medium: Interactive page (index.html): one hourly record of dissolved oxygen in the Potomac shown as the two pictures the makers were given (300x90 and 40x12 pixels), as the record itself, and with the water temperature from the same sonde laid over it; the twelve still works the makers made, grouped by what they were given and labelled with what each named; the predictions and their outcomes. A figure (figure.svg); reproducibility and git-order verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Perceiving, when the material's regular is one it shares with the family's default. Makers who measured the river's daily swing named air temperature, as did makers who supplied the day from a sentence; makers given no count named a tide. The name came from the regular held, not from measuring; none reached oxygen.
project_step: Nineteenth experiment of the project. Operation: perceiving (with finding a form). Takes up experiment 18's open threads 1 (a material whose regular can be supplied, with a true kind that is not the family's default for it) and 2 (withhold the count as well as the sentence, F-224). Keeps experiment 18's grains, render, rooms, brief and both blind coders; changes the material and the three cells. Decides S123.SUPPLIED (held, by one maker) and shows its first half wrong: a measured regular named the world wrongly four times in four. Works against the reading of ATP 12-13 that experiment 18 took (measured = map, supplied = tracing), as Cartography, not Tracing gives the map and the tracing.
material: USGS 01646500, Potomac River near Washington, DC, Little Falls Pump Station: dissolved oxygen (00300) and water temperature (00010), 5-minute values from one sonde, 1 Jul - 31 Aug 2025 00:00 UTC, all approved, averaged to 1,464 hourly values; daily discharge (00060). U.S. Geological Survey, public domain, fetched 2026-10-14. Domain: river oxygen (aquatic metabolism).
seed: prepare.py seed 124 (cells); coders.py seed 1241 (coder A's order); makers and coders are model instances and not seeded
